messages:
lee: Morning — noticed a $13.8k GPU charge attributed to project 'comet-staging' last night, appears untagged at the VM level.
anita: is that the staging customer or internal tests?
lee: billing export shows VM-level labels blank but job-level metadata indicates it was a customer migration test. SQL I ran:

SELECT resource_name, sku_description, usage_start_time, project, labels
FROM gcp_billing_export
WHERE project = 'comet-staging' AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-09-10' AND '2026-09-11'
ORDER BY usage_start_time;

Result: 3 nodes, multi-GPU each, several reboots due to preemptions.
tom: instance names? I can trace back to orchestration events.
lee: comet-mig-11, comet-mig-12, comet-mig-13 — spun up 2026-09-10T23:12 -> 2026-09-11T04:20.
ops-bot: Automated: Created incident FIN-8247 for untagged GPU spend > $5k on project comet-staging.
anita: product: was this part of the paid migration support?
finance-director: Contract note: CometInc is on migration assistance plan with a $2k/month credit. Anything beyond is billable unless we approve a courtesy credit.
lee: I pulled the orchestration logs and matched the run ids. It looks customer-triggered via support ticket #SUP-1287. They requested a full dataset migration and we enabled burst mode temporarily.
anita: ok so it's customer-triggered — recommend we bill, but offer a one-time mitigation credit of $2k. That leaves $11.8k to invoice.
billing-bot: Automated: Draft billing adjustment ADJ-1704 created for $11,800 to be invoiced to CometInc. Assigned to anita.
lee: for the billing pipeline backfill, CSV prepared for re-ingest:

resource_name,labels.team,labels.customer,usage_start,usage_end,cost
comet-mig-11,migration-team,CometInc,2026-09-10T23:12,2026-09-11T01:40,4600
comet-mig-12,migration-team,CometInc,2026-09-10T23:20,2026-09-11T03:50,5200
comet-mig-13,migration-team,CometInc,2026-09-11T00:05,2026-09-11T04:20,4000

anita: when re-ingesting please tag invoice memo: "Provisional billing for migration burst; $2k courtesy credit applied; subject to support ticket review."
legal: please include support ticket link and customer-signed migration request in the packet before sending.
finance-director: approve provisional adjustment and memo. After backfill, I'll review and we can send a pre-bill notification to the customer.
lee: action items: 1) push CSV to billing backfill job (I'll start now), 2) add a per-project migration cap of $10k/day for future migrations unless Finance signs off, 3) add CI check to ensure VM-level labels mirror job metadata.
tom: noted — PR for the label sync check in flight, will include a test for migration flows.
ops-bot: Automated: Created alert rule change REQUEST-213 to add per-project daily cap notifications for migration projects.
billing-bot: Automated: Backfill job JOB-BACKFILL-421 queued; will post status in #billing-updates.
anita: once JOB-BACKFILL-421 completes, I'll finalize ADJ-1704 and route to accounting. Also cc'ing legal on pre-bill copy.
lee: adding: let's add this incident to the migration runbook and include a checklist for support to confirm expected GPU hours before enabling burst.
finance-director: good idea. Also increase alert sensitivity: flag any untagged GPU spend > $1k within 3h for staging/migration projects.
anita: thanks team. I'll update the invoice memo and proceed after backfill success.
thread_summary: Untagged GPU spend (~$13.8k) in 'comet-staging' traced to a customer-triggered migration burst. Decided provisional billing: invoice $11.8k to CometInc with $2k courtesy credit. Actions: backfill VM labels, queue billing adjustment ADJ-1704, add migration per-project caps, CI/label sync PR, and stronger alerts for migration projects.
